purpose: Independently check KB and Suggestions tests-first raw-row extractions preserve legacy statistics.

KB ungrouped empty-event response representation is not separately pinned by a new real-reader test.

validation_limits: No duplicate test runs performed during this cross-review; inspected root baseline/after evidence and source.
